title: Stonehenge
notes: Stonehenge, a group of very large granite boulders standing on sand off the north-western tip of Similan Island 4 (Ko Miang); coastline from OpenStreetMap. The boulders are drawn as one mark at the divezone position (8.57878, 97.62772), which agrees with Similan Diving Tours ('the north-western tip of Koh Miang') and the Similan Diving Safaris overview. The tops are at about 24 m and the sand at 35-40 m, with swim-throughs, canyons and gorgonian-lined valleys between the rocks and a mooring line for the descent; their individual layout is unknown. The site coordinates (8.5775, 97.641) are 1.5 km east, off the north coast.
